title: Launch brief
idea: Launch brief: The actual product, release status and main capability appear together before explanation of what is available now.
audience: People who need to understand release within a marketing surface.
worksWellWhen: Visitors need to distinguish a released offer from an announcement.
avoidWhen: A countdown or waitlist would imply unsupported demand.
distinctFrom: Differs from a generic editorial layout through its understand release priority and explicit commitment contract: State current availability and label prototypes or planned features.
navigation: Launch brief keeps the current understand release context visible; secondary detail has an explicit return path.

composition.entry: The actual product, release status and main capability appear together before explanation of what is available now.
composition.continuation: Continue with the evidence and controls needed to understand release; visitors need to distinguish a released offer from an announcement.
composition.priority: State current availability and label prototypes or planned features.

imagery.role: Support the actual understand release context; essential controls and state remain native.

brandConstraints: Preserve approved identity, semantic roles and licensed assets.
Treat font and palette suggestions as optional; do not replace fixed branding.
responsiveRules: Keep release conditions and primary action in the first phone reading segment.
Use a legible phone reading order; media never blocks the primary proposition.

stateContracts.loading: Keep the launch brief structure stable while authoritative content resolves; expose unavailable action state.
stateContracts.empty: Explain why no understand release content is available and offer a relevant next action.
stateContracts.failure: Preserve safe context and identify the failed operation; State current availability and label prototypes or planned features.
stateContracts.offline: Label cached/unsynchronized understand release content and prevent claims of server completion.
stateContracts.success: State current availability and label prototypes or planned features.
stateContracts.interruption: Restore the active understand release context safely after navigation, focus loss or platform interruption; do not replay committed actions.

accessibilityRisks: Do not communicate state through color alone; name controls and expose current selection.
Verify reading order, input alternatives, enlarged text and focus restoration for this composition.

performanceBudget.principle: Set an explicit project budget from the actual content/device; no unsupported universal frame or bundle promise.
performanceBudget.verify: Measure initial transfer, layout stability and real image decode cost at the chosen device.

reviewNotes: Original authored candidate; no representative render, independent craft review or task evaluation is attached. Structural validation is not visual validation.
